cohort: The study participants were preterm neonates born to mothers with preeclampsia and those born to mothers without preeclampsia.
finding: Maternal preeclampsia significantly affected the gut microbial composition and diversity of preterm neonates at 2 weeks postpartum, showing lower diversity and altered bacterial abundances (e.g., lower Actinobacteria, higher Escherichia, Enterococcus, Klebsiella, lower Bifidobacterium, Cutibacterium) in the PE group compared to the non-PE group.
